editorial_intro: Vikrant Massey's Musafir Cafe brings a sweeping romantic saga to Netflix this week. Tamil crime comedy Con City follows a scammer family on a wild rescue mission, Tovino Thomas leads the stylish thriller Pallichattambi on SonyLiv, and Kay Kay Menon delivers laughs in Adarsh Baal Vidyalaya on Prime Video. Plus, Meryl Streep and Anne Hathaway reunite for The Devil Wears Prada 2 on JioHotstar.

picks.title: Musafir Cafe
picks.synopsis: Software engineer Chander Mohan Sharma moves to the mountains to become a writer and falls for Sudha, a spirited divorce lawyer. Years later, he builds a quiet life with Preeti, but memories of his past love challenge his understanding of second chances across different timelines. Based on Divya Prakash Dubey's novel.
picks.why_watch: Vikrant Massey's first outing as actor-producer — an emotional multi-timeline love story set between Bhopal and Mussoorie.

picks.title: Con City
picks.synopsis: Saravanan, Mithra, Jackie, and Janaki pose as an ordinary middle-class family running a hotel in coastal Karnataka while hiding troubled pasts. When the boy in their care is kidnapped, the unlikely team reunites for one final, elaborate scam — leading to a series of thrilling and comedic twists.
picks.why_watch: Arjun Das (Kaithi, Master) leads a delightful crime comedy about a family of con artists with hearts of gold. IMDB 8.9/10.

picks.title: Pallichattambi
picks.synopsis: Chattambi, a scheming man in a small town, survives by staying ahead of his neighbors through risky plans. When his schemes backfire spectacularly, his survival depends on extricating himself from the mess he created. Tovino Thomas delivers another powerhouse performance in this gripping Malayalam thriller.
picks.why_watch: Tovino Thomas and a surprise Prithviraj Sukumaran appearance in a stylish small-town thriller from the Pani director.

picks.title: Adarsh Baal Vidyalaya
picks.synopsis: Set in a dysfunctional government school on the outskirts of Delhi, unconventional headmaster Gyaneshwar Tripathi discovers that the top ten principals with the best board results win a trip to Cambridge. He rallies a mismatched crew of eccentric teachers to overhaul the school through hilarious chaos and heartwarming perseverance.
picks.why_watch: Kay Kay Menon as a lovable headmaster in a feel-good comedy about India's underfunded schools — a perfect binge.

picks.title: Secret Of Kalinga
picks.synopsis: A college sits on ancient Kalinga kingdom land. Behind it, a forest well holds a princess's spirit imprisoned centuries ago. When students accidentally break the seal on New Year's Eve, they trigger comedic supernatural chaos that threatens the entire campus.
picks.why_watch: A fun Malayalam horror-comedy mixing ancient legends with college antics — rated 7.6/10 on IMDB.

picks.title: The Devil Wears Prada 2
picks.synopsis: Twenty years later, Andy Sachs has left Runway magazine for a newsroom career. When Miranda Priestly faces a public scandal, Runway's owner hires Andy as features editor without Miranda's approval, forcing the two to work together as the legendary publication fights for survival in the digital era.
picks.why_watch: The fashion sequel that broke trailer records — Meryl, Anne, and Emily reunite with cameos by Lady Gaga, Lucy Liu, and Sydney Sweeney. Streaming on Disney+/Hulu July 29 in the US.

picks.title: Star Trek: Strange New Worlds Season 4
picks.synopsis: The USS Enterprise prequel returns with Captain Pike and crew facing new challenges aboard the iconic starship. The penultimate season of the critically acclaimed series that introduced younger versions of classic Star Trek characters continues its episodic adventure format.
picks.why_watch: One of Trek's most beloved modern series returns — and with a final season already in production, this is the beginning of the end.

picks.title: A Toxic Love Story
picks.synopsis: A string of threatening emails escalates into a revenge plot involving a newly married US marshal and his ex-girlfriend in this gripping true-crime documentary that unfolds like a thriller.
picks.why_watch: Netflix's latest true-crime obsession — a real-life revenge plot that's stranger than fiction.

picks.title: My Daughter's Father
picks.synopsis: A multi-lingual family drama available in Spanish, English, and Hindi that explores the complex bonds between parents and children across cultures.
picks.why_watch: A fresh Netflix series available in Hindi alongside Spanish and English — a global family drama.

picks.title: Ransom Canyon Season 2
picks.synopsis: Six months after the events of Season 1, rancher Staten Kirkland is still fighting to reclaim the Double K Ranch while Quinn O'Grady returns to her hometown, reigniting old tensions and new romance in the Texas hill country.
picks.why_watch: The sleeper-hit romantic drama returns for a second season with Josh Duhamel and Minka Kelly.
